summary: Add privacy-safe first-suggestion latency diagnostics with P50/P95/P99 reporting to BR Brain. Preserve voice noise-mode choices across upgrades and correct offline voice documentation.

changes.title: Measure first-suggestion responsiveness
changes.detail: BR Brain now reports local time from a letter key event to the next suggestion-strip pre-draw and synchronous suggestion-strip update time, separately from dictionary computation time, with P50/P95/P99 over a bounded recent sample window. It stores no typed text or editor identity, excludes incognito, password, secure-app and no-personal-learning fields, discards stale samples, and keeps measurements only in memory. A pre-draw is not proof that the display presented the frame.

changes.title: Keep voice processing choices during update
changes.detail: Preserve an existing explicit Android NoiseSuppressor or OFF choice when upgrading from the legacy setting. New installs still default to brrClean, and saved current modes remain authoritative. Update the voice guide to explain local brrClean processing, raw-audio fallback, bounded streaming, and microphone routing limits. No prediction model weights or network permission are added.
